resources.string: Your contacts are not told your new address. Give it to them yourself; until they have it, what they send to your old address does not reach this new wallet.
Your contacts are not told about the new address. Give it to them yourself if you want them to use it.
Shielded messages travel inside Zcash transactions, so each one costs ZEC.

A short Shielded message costs at least 0.00017 ZEC: the Zcash network fee, a 0.00001 ZEC ZChat fee, and 0.00001 ZEC delivered with the message. Longer messages, photos and wallets holding many small amounts cost more.
Send 0.005 ZEC so they can start messaging (about 25 short Shielded messages)
Sending on the Zcash network — usually a few minutes
Still sending after %1$d min. Your ZEC may still be confirming. Keep ZChat open; if it can\'t go out, you\'ll see Retry.
Waiting for your ZEC to confirm: %1$d of %2$d, about %3$d min. It sends by itself while ZChat is open. If ZChat closes, it continues when you reopen it within an hour.
Waiting for a secure connection. It completes when your contact opens ZChat.
Not connected after %1$d min. Ask your contact to open ZChat 2.13 or newer. Your message is kept and goes out when they connect.
ZCHAT sends messages only from Ironwood, the Zcash shielded pool new funds go to. Sending from Sapling or transparent funds would make the amount public.
Shield your funds into Ironwood to send messages.
